title: A reply notice sent to a leader or a Space owner opens their own inbox instead of the staff-only page

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (thread: Check every email and message system)

detail:
2026-11-18: notifyConversationReply (lib/comms/inbound.ts) writes reference_type 'conversation' for the conversation owner, and lib/notifications/href.ts sends 'conversation' to /admin/crm/conversations, which requires staff. Leaders (kind leader, inbox /lead/inbox) and Space owners (Space-lane threads under /spaces/[slug]/crm/conversations) are bounced by every reply bell. Same class as LIVE-505. Done when the bell row carries a destination the owner can open.

notifyConversationReply now writes reference_type by the thread's lane (lib/comms/reply-bell.ts): leader_conversation opens /lead/inbox?id=, space_conversation opens /spaces/operating?conversation=<id>, which forwards the thread's owner or assignee to /spaces/<slug>/crm/conversations?id= (the row carries only a UUID, so the slug resolves on arrival), and a platform thread keeps /admin/crm/conversations. Tests in lib/comms/reply-bell.test.ts and lib/notifications/href.test.ts.

verify.note: Passes once a reply bell can open the leader inbox instead of only the staff workspace.
